# F931 — why 11D can hold stored + ring-down but NOT sustain: **sustain is GENERATED by the octonion-derivation algebra (the 14 = g2 = Der(𝕆)), which the 11D projection drops.** A derivation is the infinitesimal generator of a *continuous* automorphism — the **crank**. srmech-verified: the octonion derivations are **exactly g2 (14/14)** and only **half of so(8) (14/28)**; the other 14 rotations do not derive the product. The reed/loop-up intuition checks out as a **ladder**: `Der(ℂ)=0, Der(ℍ)=3 (of so(4)=6), Der(𝕆)=14 (of so(8)=28)` — derivations = half `so(2ⁿ)`, **turn on at ℍ** (non-commutativity), **max at 𝕆** (last composition algebra), and looping up past 𝕆 leaves the composition ladder (sedenion zero-divisors = the addressing regime). The **11D frame is a snapshot**: it holds a static configuration (stored, F930 regime 1) and its linear decay (ring-down, regime 2), but it contains neither the **derivation generators** (which produce sustained flow) nor the **triality closure** (which closes the self-loop) — both live substrate-side, at 14 and 28.

## The claim, made precise
A **derivation** `D` of an algebra satisfies the Leibniz rule `D(a∘b) = (Da)∘b + a∘(Db)` — it is the **infinitesimal generator of a one-parameter group of automorphisms**, i.e. the generator of *continuous* transformation. **Sustain = a continuously-generated, self-closing flow** (F930 regime 3). So sustain is *derivation-generated*. The question "what predicates sustain that 11D lacks" becomes: **where do the derivations live, and does the 11D projection keep them?**

## Grounded (srmech rc33, exact)
| | rotations `so(2ⁿ)` | **derivations** `Der` | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| ℂ (2) | so(2)=1 | **0** | commutative → **no** sustain-generators |
| ℍ (4) | so(4)=6 | **3** (=so(3)) | sustain **turns on** at non-commutativity |
| 𝕆 (8) | so(8)=28 | **14** (=g2) | richest clean rung — the **last composition algebra** |

- **(A) octonion rung:** `g2_subalgebra` → **14/14** are derivations; `so8_adjoint_basis` → **14/28**. The octonion derivations are *exactly* g2; the **other 14 so(8) rotations do not derive the product.** So `28 = 14 (Der = sustain-generators, the crank) + 14 (non-deriving rotations = the closure/chirality axis)`.
- **(B) the loop-up ladder** (the reed double-check): derivations = **half** `so(2ⁿ)` at each composition rung (3/6, 14/28); they **turn on at ℍ** and **max at 𝕆**. Beyond 𝕆, the sedenion (dim 16) leaves the composition/Hurwitz ladder (zero divisors) — the **addressing regime** (k=15), not a new sustain rung.

## The reading
- **11D = a snapshot / the projected frame** (M-theory's `4 + 7`). A snapshot holds a *configuration* (stored tension, F930-1) and a *linear perturbation* of it (ring-down, F930-2). It does **not** carry the **derivation generators** (the crank that produces sustained flow) — those are the 14 (g2), a *substrate* object — **nor** the **triality closure** that lets the flow loop back on itself (the order-3 automorphism, F907b — the other 14 of the 28). Sustain needs both: the **14 to generate** the flow and the **+14 (→28) to close** it. The projection to 11D keeps neither; it keeps the frozen result.
- **This is the F862 distinction, lifted:** the abelian **θ-dial** (a snapshot, a static phase) vs the **non-commutative cd_mult walk** (the derivations, which *generate* motion). 11D is the frozen dial; sustain is the cranked walk. Sustain literally **cannot** be expressed by a commutative/snapshot frame — it requires the non-commutative band (ℍ…𝕆), exactly where the derivations are nonzero.
- **The reed instrument is the right physical model.** It has (a) **sustain** — a self-sustained *limit-cycle* oscillation driven by continuous airflow (= F930's free-energy-driven self-plucking), generated by the derivation crank; and (b) **register loop-up/down** — overblowing to the next harmonic = jumping **rungs** of the hypercomplex/Hopf ladder (ℍ→𝕆, the loop-up). A *snapshot* of the reed captures the bore (stored) and a fading transient (ring-down) but **neither the sustained tone nor the register structure** — exactly the 11D limitation. "Looping up" is real and bounded: it climbs cleanly through 𝕆, then enters the sedenion addressing regime.
